i.norm: Verifies that replaceIn returns false and the default escape character is '$' when preserveEscapes is enabled and the buffer contains an escaped variable prefix ("$$") followed by an unclosed variable reference ("${"). The buffer content after setup is: "}\0\0\0\0$${", which has no resolvable variable, so no substitution occurs.
Build the input buffer: start with "}", then append null chars with a trailing '$', then append "${" — resulting in "}\0\0\0\0$${".
No variable can be resolved, so replaceIn must report no substitution.
The default escape character for StringSubstitutor is '$'.
